notes.title: 1 December 2023 Patch
notes.content:
Explanations added for upgrades.

You can change the weapons parts except first weapons core.

Stocks and bodies can be  stacked now. When you put a new stock or body its stats will be stacked. For example if you attach 2 stock with +5 damage weapons damage will be +10.

notes.title: 28 November 2023 Patch
notes.content:
Enemies are stronger on late levels.

Apple is added. Apple restores 1 health.

Every 50 seconds an apple is created.

Bosses drop apple.

! events are easier now.
